p0_scope: Blocking findings in the failed M496 r3 design/evidence, not integrity failures in this review package.

failure_classification.immediate_termination: Synopsys DC V-2023.12-SP3 internal fatal error id 263749 while compile -incremental_mapping -only_hold_time attempted a timing update on the already-looped graph
failure_classification.reason: check_timing_precompile reports two timing loops before ungroup or any compile. The same service/adapter loop nodes reappear in compile_ultra, compile_ultra -incremental, and the fatal hold-only update.

dependency_chain: M219 legal_response_accept depends on mem_rsp_valid and mem_rsp_ready
M219 free_slot_found and head_context_open include same-edge legal_response_accept release
M219 mem_req_valid depends on free_slot_found and head_context_open
adapter illegal_request and protocol_error depend on core_req_valid, which is M219 mem_req_valid
adapter core_rsp_valid is gated by protocol_error, closing the response-to-request-to-response combinational cycle

p0_findings.finding: Two timing loops exist in the elaborated K1 graph before any compile. They cross the M219 response-release/request-valid path and M499 request-fault/response-valid gating. A timing graph with disabled loop arcs is not admissible physical evidence.
K1 exits 1 before postcompile reports/netlist, while K8 and K1x8 never start. No area, setup, hold, constraint, throughput-per-area or Pareto value is admissible from r3.

p1_findings.finding: The runner saves check_timing_precompile but does not fail immediately on TIM-209, allowing approximately 98 minutes of mapping before the deterministic loop reaches a fatal timing update.
Existing VCS/SVA proves sampled functional transactions and arithmetic, but not an acyclic combinational timing graph; the recovery gate needs explicit synthesis precompile loop rejection.
The Synopsys stack and crte snapshot are present and fingerprinted by this review but were written outside the quarantined run directory and are not members of its failure package.

citation_boundary.reason: These are transient optimizer table values on a graph with disabled loop arcs, not final report_area/report_timing outputs; the flow later exits 1 and never emits required reports.

recovery_ruling.authorization_scope: Design and independently review one new loop-cut RTL/contract/runner identity only; this review does not itself authorize launching VCS or DC.
preferred_minimal_rtl_change: In M219, allocate a slot only from registered !sb_valid_q; remove same-edge legal_response_accept slot reuse from free_slot_found.
In M219, open a context only from registered !ctx_busy_q; remove same-edge response_releases_head_context bypass.
The accepted response clears registered state at the edge, so the next request may issue on the following cycle.
recovery_ruling.why_preferred: This cuts mem_rsp_valid-to-mem_req_valid combinational dependence at its source without weakening protocol legality, timing constraints, libraries or compile effort.
